text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer's connection to the Aspiration scandal
quotes.excerpt: Mr. Ballmer's connection to Sanberg is what caused a former talking head and television personality, Pablo Torre
quotes.quote: Mr. Ballmer's connection to Sanberg is what caused a former talking head and television personality, Pablo Torre, to launch a relentless vitriolic public campaign against Mr. Ballmer, alleging, principally based on anonymized gossip, as well as on a misapprehension or intentional disregard of the facts, that Mr. Ballmer conspired with Sanberg and Aspiration to engage in the circumvention of the NBA's salary cap by virtue of an endorsement deal between Aspiration and one of the team's star players, Kawhi Leonard.

quotes.speaker: David Samson

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: It is so beautiful, Pablo, because if you read these two quotes side by side, it is virtually impossible even for a Harvard guy to walk the tightrope where you do a show where both sides say you screwed them. And it just is a chef's kiss to journalism that you could do a show that both sides believe put them in a position where they had to fight back.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: Both Sanberg and Ballmer, incidentally, all Harvard guys, and they are ganging up on the journalist.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: You know, I always like it when you click on my profile. I check it out.

quotes.quote: It is also to help me understand a side deal that both men made and managed to keep extraordinarily quiet for five fucking years, until, of course, this new episode of their favorite podcast.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Joseph Sanberg sentenced to 14 years for defrauding investors
quotes.excerpt: Aspiration founder Joseph Sanberg has been sentenced to 14 years in prison for defrauding investors
quotes.quote: Aspiration founder Joseph Sanberg has been sentenced to 14 years in prison for defrauding investors of $248 million, per Baxter. He and the Clippers are being investigated by the NBA for paying Kawhi under the table.

quotes.speaker: Lou Manzo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Manzo compares Sanberg's fraud to Holmes and Javice
quotes.excerpt: I think you can compare it to a couple of the major fraud cases
quotes.quote: I think you can compare it to a couple of the major fraud cases that have been in popular media lately. Elizabeth Holmes, she got 10 years for Theranos. And then you've got Charlie Javice in New York, that was the Frank case where she sold her business to JP Morgan, it was all fraud. She went to trial, got convicted, again, huge expenditure of resources, and she got seven years.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the sentencing disparity in the Sanberg case
quotes.excerpt: What shocks me, Lou, is that the bid and the ask here was 17 and a half and zero.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: What shocks me, Lou, is that the bid and the ask here was 17 and a half and zero.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: Yeah, that's a huge delta.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: That is a huge delta, and where it came down was clearly on the side of the DOJ.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: I want to clarify that the DOJ recommended, yes, the sentence of 17 and a half years based on total losses in their accounting of $248 million.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: Judge Wilson's assessment of Joseph Sanberg's fraud
quotes.excerpt: the circumstances are among the worst that I have ever encountered in my 40 years serving here.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: The history of this defendant is that he is charitable, wants to do good things, wants to do things he thinks are important, but the circumstances are among the worst that I have ever encountered in my 40 years serving here. He started with altruistic intentions, but he became entangled in a web of lies that continued for four years. I would put the grade of this fraud at the zenith.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: It is literally the highest possible point, the zenith, I believe.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: I don't know what happens going forward for this judge because if this is the zenith, definitionally, no one will get 14 years in his courtroom again.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: Maybe he was hoping for a seven or an eight. 14 definitely sticks out.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson describes Sanberg's reaction to his sentencing
quotes.excerpt: I'm seeing someone basically gesticulating as though they cannot believe what happened

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: I'm seeing someone basically gesticulating as though they cannot believe what happened, holding a file saying, did this just happen? Am I really 14 years? I can't read the lips exactly, but it looks as though he is less than happy.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: What Sanberg told the judge on Monday, in part, was, quote, I lost my moral compass.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: In my mind, maybe he was hoping for a seven or an eight. 14 definitely sticks out.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the importance of victim impact statements
quotes.excerpt: the more widows and orphans you can get to be defrauded, the better chance you have

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: What we call them in law school, it's I'm sorry to tell you, widows and orphans. The more widows and orphans you can get to be defrauded, the better chance you have of getting the bigger sentence because it is a terrible story to tell. Steve Ballmer losing $60 million is not even remotely close to a widow losing $100,000 or $10,000 or an orphan losing $5,000.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: So you're looking for the most people you can find to come provide victim impact statements and actually show up to the hearing if you're the DOJ, because it's more meaningful.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: And I think that's what separated this from Elizabeth Holmes and Charlie Javice, is that it's not just, you know, UBS or JP Morgan or Sequoia, but individuals with investments as small as $5,000, which is pretty shocking.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on how investors got rich without IPO regulations
quotes.excerpt: it's the way people got rich without any of the regulation that exists when you are doing an IPO.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: To put it in even more plain English, it's the way people got rich without any of the regulation that exists when you are doing an IPO.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: Right. And then it, by the way, if you look today, it's basically falling apart.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: You could get away with information in a SPAC that was less investigated and go faster. So that's what a lot of companies were doing.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Pablo Torre on the secret funding relationship between Ballmer and Sanberg
quotes.excerpt: Steve Ballmer has been paying Aspiration and Aspiration has been paying Steve Ballmer
quotes.quote: This whole thing where Joe would generate business that ended up actually being business that he was effectively funding, that was getting paid back to him, I do just want to reference that in the DOJ memo, one of the things they point out is that what Sanberg would be doing individually through his own vehicles is paying for sham services presented as marketing and branding services often, which then paid Aspiration.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson explains the mechanics of a put right option
quotes.excerpt: you have the opportunity to cash in something that you have taken into your possession.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: When you get an option, a put right option, it means that you have the opportunity to cash in something that you have taken into your possession. You can take it into possession and then literally, think of the word, you can put it back. I'm putting it back, I'm giving it back to you, give me back money.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: Kawhi Leonard, for those who have not been keeping up, not only got signed to a no-show $28 million endorsement deal that was kept secret, he also happened to receive a special put right option on $20 million worth of Aspiration equity that Joe Sanberg personally awarded him.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: Nothing here makes sense, right? That you're going to have somebody who is very much not a dynamic speaker, it's a great basketball player, but not a dynamic speaker and who has no social media presence and doesn't want to talk about anything, but play basketball.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the credit risk of put right options
quotes.excerpt: it's only as good as the credit of the person who gives the put.

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: But it's only as good as the credit of the person who gives the put. So if you get a put and you put stock back and the stock is meaningless and also the person you are putting the stock back to doesn't have three nickels to rub together to make a dime, then what's the use of the put?

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: This is derisking an investment, which is a hell of a benefit to negotiate off to the side.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: Right, you get a floor, and that's the benefit of this, that it doesn't go to zero, it goes to a floor, and that floor is, you know, negotiated in the contract.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the secret side deal between Ballmer and Sanberg
quotes.excerpt: What an interesting decision by Ballmer's lawyers to disclose this in a victim impact statement

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: What an interesting decision by Ballmer's lawyers to disclose this in a victim impact statement while also in the middle of a lawsuit with other investors who would have liked to have known this material side agreement existed as it would likely have impacted their own investment.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: Steve Ballmer is admitting a half decade late that he had his own hidden arrangement with Joe, changing an investment of $50 million into a relatively, again, risk-free loan with a personal IOU that derisked the celebrity VIP that came in to boost the reputation of the company.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: I think your theory is the most likely. You generally want to take the sting out. So you say, this isn't news, I've disclosed this. It has been known in the public sphere.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the binary nature of the put right disclosure
quotes.excerpt: Either this put right was a material representation that was not disclosed

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: Either this put right was a material representation that was not disclosed, or it was immaterial for SEC purposes, but material for salary cap circumvention. To me, it is very binary, and I look forward to Steve somehow teaching me why it is something in the middle.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: I think there is a one word summary, which I'd hope you could provide us at the end here, because the answer to my question is therefore...

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: Guilty.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Pablo Torre on the SEC's investigation into Aspiration
quotes.excerpt: I have been spending many, many, many hours of my own looking for any evidence of previous disclosure
quotes.quote: I have been spending many, many, many hours of my own looking for any evidence of previous disclosure across the 3,000 pages of documents and more that I've gotten and otherwise. And so what I can tell you is that, according to one set of emails with Sanberg and potential Aspiration investors that he was pitching, this of February 2023, there are attached financial documents and an Aspiration cap table that mention the Ballmer investment, but they do not disclose the put option.

quotes.speaker: David Samson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Samson on the implications of Ballmer's victim impact statement
quotes.excerpt: Ballmer is doing something and we don't know why, though we certainly can speculate

text_blocks.speaker: David Samson
text_blocks.text: Ballmer is doing something and we don't know why, though we certainly can speculate, as he's sending this impact statement to Judge Wilson prior to sentencing, prior to sentencing in LA, where Joe got the 14 years, or in a law firm's report to NBA Commissioner Adam Silver that is expected, eventually, maybe this summer, in order to claim, self-protectively, that Ballmer himself had already disclosed this.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: But Wachtell, the lead investigator, did not respond to my request for comment about this.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Manzo
text_blocks.text: I think your theory is the most likely. You generally want to take the sting out. So you say, this isn't news, I've disclosed this. It has been known in the public sphere.
